name: btrc
description: Language support for btrc — a language that transpiles to C

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The btrc language server and debugger execute project-local compiler and environment configuration.

program.description: Absolute path to the .btrc file to compile and debug.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the debugged program.

stopOnEntry.description: Break at the program's entry point.

cwd.description: Working directory for the debugged program.

btrcpy.description: Command that runs the btrc compiler (e.g. "bin/btrcpy"). Auto-detected from the workspace when omitted.

cc.description: C compiler used to build the debug binary.

cflags.description: Extra flags passed to the C compiler.

configurationSnippets.label: btrc: Debug current file
configurationSnippets.description: Compile the active .btrc file with debug info and debug it

btrc.pythonPath.description: Path to a Python 3.13+ interpreter for the bundled btrc language server and compiler. When empty, uses python on Windows and python3 elsewhere.

btrc.serverPath.description: Absolute path to the btrc LSP server script (server.py). When set, the extension uses this directly instead of searching for it.

btrc.serverCommand.description: Foreground command or absolute path for the btrc language server, defaulting to btrc-lsp. The command must remain alive for the server lifetime; daemonizing wrappers cannot be owned reliably on Windows. Workspace direnv takes precedence for relative commands; shell.nix and flake.nix also take precedence when btrc.useNixDevShell is enabled.

btrc.useNixDevShell.description: When enabled, use a workspace shell.nix or flake.nix to run the language server in its pinned Nix environment. A local src/devex/lsp/.venv or an explicit btrc.pythonPath takes precedence. Disabling this setting bypasses Nix shell discovery but still permits workspace direnv.

btrc.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the btrc language server

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run prepare-lsp && npm run esbuild-base
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run compile && node --test test/*.test.js
